messages.author: Imre Haviland
messages.text: Grant 9077 was rotated by Marijke on the 4th — those objects are superseded, nothing from them counts. 9084 is owner-held for the payments cut-over; lifting that hold is Nienke's call, not ours.

messages.author: Beatriz Soriano
messages.text: Responder 1's Monday AM is the major-incident bridge and stays protected. If anyone wants an out-of-hours block for a tenant-wide sign-out, that is a separate request to me — nothing pre-approved.

messages.author: Solène Delacroix
messages.text: The regulator session is 09:00 Thursday the 18th. Whatever containment date we put in the briefing has to be real.
